Diaz Reus International Law Firm (“DRT”) issues this notice to alert the community concerning impersonation attempts. Scammers have sought to misuse our name, as well as the names of DRT attorneys, to falsely offer professional services. Please note that DRT never requests personal information through unofficial websites. Authentic communications originate only from email addresses ending in @diazreus.com or phone numbers listed on diazreus.com. If you are uncertain about the source of any communication using our name, please contact us immediately at info@diazreus.com or +1 (305) 375-9220.All locations
